basePrompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: production iPhone fitness app template-mask icon, one member of a coherent five-icon anatomical family. Create ONE square 1024 x 1024 PNG. Flat pure white (#FFFFFF) filled silhouette, genuinely transparent background if supported; if transparency unavailable use perfectly solid pure black (#000000) background instead. Crisp smooth edges with only edge antialiasing. Strong compact anatomical shape, bold cut-paper pictogram with subtly rounded corners, broad filled masses. Center the glyph optically in a square, longest dimension approximately 760 pixels, generous equal safety margins. Must remain identifiable at only 14 pixels tall/wide inside a 24 pt tile. No outlines, no fine lines, no striations, no gradients, no shading, no gray interior, no 3D, no texture, no lettering, no labels, no badges, no exercise equipment, no person doing an exercise. Use at most one or two broad negative-space separations, each at least 65 pixels wide. Shape recognition comes entirely from the silhouette. Output only the single icon, not a contact sheet.

Two white pec masses together constitute the single glyph.

An isolated front three-quarter view muscular upper leg: broad slightly angled upper thigh cut at the hip, strong convex outer quad bulge, inward taper, teardrop-shaped inner quad just above the knee, terminating in a short clearly narrower knee stump. One compact solid white connected silhouette, long axis near vertical with slight dynamic diagonal. Emphasize thick thigh and asymmetric quad outline so it reads as upper leg muscle. No foot, calf, pelvis, torso, stripes, interior lines or separated floating details.

refinePrompt: Refine this generated icon into a pristine production stencil. Preserve its anatomical subject and overall silhouette. Output exactly 1024 x 1024. Use only solid pure white for the filled glyph and an opaque solid pure black background. Do NOT use transparency, do NOT remove the background. Remove every fleck, halo, fringe, hairline, contour stroke, gradient, shading, texture and tiny interior cut. The white must be uniformly #FFFFFF and background uniformly #000000, with crisp smoothly antialiased edges only. Clean flat 2D vector-like icon. Keep glyph centered, at 80 percent of canvas on its longest dimension, maintaining the current aspect ratio. No labels or extras.
